question: Який сумарний обсяг переданої електроенергії та питомий коефіцієнт втрат за енергетичними районами?
baseline_llm_sql:
SELECT
    s.region_cluster AS region_cluster,
    ROUND(SUM(f.energy_transmitted_mwh), 2) AS total_energy_mwh,
    ROUND(SUM(f.tech_losses_mwh) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(f.energy_transmitted_mwh), 0), 3) AS loss_rate_pct
FROM fact_grid_telemetry f
JOIN dim_substation s ON f.substation_key = s.substation_key
GROUP BY s.region_cluster
ORDER BY region_cluster;
validated_sql: SELECT s.region_cluster AS region_cluster, ROUND(SUM(f.energy_transmitted_mwh), 2) AS total_energy_mwh, ROUND(SUM(f.tech_losses_mwh) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(f.energy_transmitted_mwh), 0), 3) AS loss_rate_pct FROM fact_grid_telemetry AS f JOIN dim_substation AS s ON f.substation_key = s.substation_key GROUP BY s.region_cluster ORDER BY region_cluster LIMIT 100

question: Яка питома тривалість аварійного простою на одиницю обладнання та частота спрацювань РЗА за класами таксономії?
baseline_llm_sql:
SELECT
    t.class_level1_name AS class_level1_name,
    SUM(f.protection_trips_count) AS protection_trip_frequency,
    ROUND(SUM(f.outage_duration_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.taxonomy_key), 0), 2) AS saidi_outage_min_per_unit
FROM fact_grid_telemetry f
JOIN dim_taxonomy_equipment t ON f.taxonomy_key = t.taxonomy_key AND t.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY t.class_level1_name
ORDER BY class_level1_name;
validated_sql: SELECT t.class_level1_name AS class_level1_name, SUM(f.protection_trips_count) AS protection_trip_frequency, ROUND(SUM(f.outage_duration_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.taxonomy_key), 0), 2) AS saidi_outage_min_per_unit FROM fact_grid_telemetry AS f JOIN dim_taxonomy_equipment AS t ON f.taxonomy_key = t.taxonomy_key AND t.is_current = TRUE GROUP BY t.class_level1_name ORDER BY class_level1_name LIMIT 100
error_note: Коректна генерація з урахуванням COUNT(DISTINCT taxonomy_key)

question: Який середній коефіцієнт завантаження та частка критичних режимів за сезонами року?
baseline_llm_sql:
SELECT
    d.season AS season,
    ROUND(AVG(f.load_factor_pct), 2) AS avg_load_factor_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.risk_score >= 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS critical_risk_rate_pct
FROM fact_grid_telemetry f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
GROUP BY d.season
ORDER BY season;
validated_sql: SELECT d.season AS season, ROUND(AVG(f.load_factor_pct), 2) AS avg_load_factor_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.risk_score >= 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS critical_risk_rate_pct FROM fact_grid_telemetry AS f JOIN dim_date AS d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.season ORDER BY season LIMIT 100

question: Як змінюється частота спрацювань РЗА та частка критичних режимів залежно від рівня ризику ожеледі?
baseline_llm_sql:
SELECT
    w.icing_risk_level AS icing_risk_level,
    SUM(f.protection_trips_count) AS protection_trip_frequency,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.risk_score >= 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS critical_risk_rate_pct
FROM fact_grid_telemetry f
JOIN dim_weather w ON f.weather_key = w.weather_key
GROUP BY w.icing_risk_level
ORDER BY icing_risk_level;
validated_sql: SELECT w.icing_risk_level AS icing_risk_level, SUM(f.protection_trips_count) AS protection_trip_frequency, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.risk_score >= 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS critical_risk_rate_pct FROM fact_grid_telemetry AS f JOIN dim_weather AS w ON f.weather_key = w.weather_key GROUP BY w.icing_risk_level ORDER BY icing_risk_level LIMIT 100

question: Покажи середнє завантаження для кожної підстанції у порядку спадання.

question: Який питомий коефіцієнт технологічних втрат (%) за класами напруги підстанцій?
baseline_llm_sql: SELECT s.voltage_class_kv, ROUND(AVG(f.tech_losses_mwh * 100.0 / f.energy_transmitted_mwh), 3) AS loss_rate_pct FROM fact_grid_telemetry f JOIN dim_substation s ON f.substation_key = s.substation_key GROUP BY s.voltage_class_kv ORDER BY s.voltage_class_kv
validated_sql: SELECT s.voltage_class_kv AS voltage_class_kv, ROUND(SUM(f.tech_losses_mwh) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(f.energy_transmitted_mwh), 0), 3) AS loss_rate_pct FROM fact_grid_telemetry AS f JOIN dim_substation AS s ON f.substation_key = s.substation_key GROUP BY s.voltage_class_kv ORDER BY voltage_class_kv LIMIT 100
error_note: Помилка E1 (Адитивність): сира модель усереднила відсотки AVG(losses/energy)=2.559% замість SUM(losses)/SUM(energy)=2.536% для 750 кВ. Виправлено семантичним шаром.

question: Яка сумарна встановлена номінальна потужність актуальних одиниць обладнання за класами таксономії?
baseline_llm_sql: SELECT class_level1_name, SUM(rated_capacity_mw) AS total_rated_mw FROM dim_taxonomy_equipment GROUP BY class_level1_name ORDER BY class_level1_name
